topic_title: Advances in 3D Reconstruction and Generative AI Models
topic_summary: Recent research papers introduce novel frameworks for 3D asset generation and scene reconstruction, including VideoRNG for relightable neural Gaussians, SceneAnything for agentic mesh scene reconstruction, Infer3D for inverse generative modeling, and VODA for volumetric 3D Gaussian segmentation. These developments address limitations in classical representations, feedforward inference, and alpha-blended feature supervision to improve 3D AI modeling.
topic_key_facts: [Webpage] VideoRNG is a two-stage method that generates complete, relightable 3D assets from a text prompt or single image.
[Webpage] SceneAnything is an automated system for reconstructing mesh scenes from real and generated videos.
[Webpage] Infer3D proposes an inverse generative modeling framework inspired by the generative nature of human vision to recover latent variables.
[Hugging Face] VODA is a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors for 3D Gaussian segmentation.

topic_title: Multi-View and Motion Pretraining Advances in Video Understanding
topic_summary: Recent research introduces advanced pretraining techniques to improve video and sign language encoders, including multi-view predictive post-training for cross-view understanding and a two-stage motion and pseudo-gloss approach for American Sign Language. Additionally, a new method called O2LaF repurposes pretrained video diffusion transformers for self-supervised latent action learning. These developments provide practitioners with enhanced methods for representation learning, motion reconstruction, and dynamics modeling.
topic_key_facts: [Webpage] MV-JEPA introduces multi-view predictive post-training to strengthen cross-view instance and temporal correspondence while retaining independent single-view inference.
[Webpage] MoGloss proposes a novel two-stage pretraining approach that first learns to reconstruct masked motion, followed by joint masked prediction of pseudo-gloss units and motion.
[Webpage] Pseudo-glosses are obtained from captions by a large language model to serve as an intermediate structured representation of natural language text.
[Webpage] A corpus of about 1,100 hours of American Sign Language was curated from five public datasets, estimating 2D pose for all clips.
[Hugging Face] O2LaF initializes both inverse and forward dynamics models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapts them to their distinct roles.
